title: Own recipe made vegan
spec: User pastes their grandmother's recipe and asks for a vegan version. AI substitutes. User rejects one substitution from experience, then reports cooking it.

messages.content:
this is my grandmas waffle recipe, can u make it vegan?

4 eggs, 100g sugar, 500ml milk, 300g flour, 100g melted butter, 1 tsp cardamom

Here's a vegan version that keeps the texture close to the original:

- 4 eggs -> 4 flax eggs (4 tbsp ground flaxseed + 12 tbsp water, rest 10 min)
- 500ml milk -> 500ml oat milk
- 100g butter -> 100g melted vegan butter or 80ml neutral oil
- Keep sugar, flour and cardamom as they are

Add 1 tsp baking powder, since without eggs the batter needs a bit more lift.
i tried flax eggs in waffles before and they came out gummy. use aquafaba instead

Good call, aquafaba gives a lighter result in waffles. Replace the flax eggs with 180ml aquafaba (the liquid from a can of chickpeas), whipped to soft peaks and folded in at the end. Keep the baking powder.
made them this morning, came out great, kids didnt notice
That's the best review a vegan recipe can get! Enjoy.
